writing_rules: Development-bank entries are sparse and created only for owners that need unresolved fractional development, an owner development cursor, or consumed exact-person breakthrough evidence.
Credits store residual development units keyed by a stable capability target, never scheduled hours or free skill points.

breakthrough_event_refs records persisted causal events already consumed by this exact person for exceptional advancement; one event may not be reused by that person across multiple capability targets.
resolved_through advances only after eligible activity through that time has been causally resolved.
A missing entry never grants progress; use the authoritative owner/process settlement cursor to begin lazy resolution.
Do not transfer credits or consumed breakthrough evidence between capability targets or owners.
